questions.question:
Identify the number that does NOT belong to the following series.

2, 6, 14, 30, 62, 126, 250
questions.solution:
Given series: 2, 6, 14, 30, 62, 126, 250

The pattern followed here is,

(2 + 1) × 2 = 6

(6 + 1) × 2 = 14

(14 + 1) × 2 = 30

(30 + 1) × 2 = 62

(62 + 1) × 2 = 126

**(126 + 1) × 3 = 254 ≠ 250**

So, instead of ‘250’, it should be ‘254’.

Hence, ‘250’ is the wrong term in the series.

questions.question: 60 students participated in one or more of the three competitions, i. e. Quiz, Extempore and Debate. A total of 22 students participated either in Quiz only or in Extempore only. 4 students participated in all three competitions. A total of 14 students participated in any of the two competitions only. How many students participated in Debated only?
questions.solution:
60 students participated in one or more of the three competitions, i. e. Quiz, and Debate. A total of 22 students participated either in Quiz only or in Extempore only.

4 students participated in all three competitions.

A total of 14 students participated in any of the two competitions only.

Number of students who participated in Debate only = 60 - (22 + 4 + 14) = 60 - 40 = 20

Hence, ‘20’ students participated in debate only.

questions.question: Which of the following years is called the Year of the Great Divide in the demographic history of India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **1921**__ is called the Year of the Great Divide in the demographic history of India. 
 
• Prior to 1921, the population was quite unstable. It kept on increasing and decreasing without any pattern.
 
• After 1921, the population showed a consistent increase.
 
• The total increase in population was 5.9% between 1901 and 1911. 
 
• The total decrease in population was 0.39% between 1911 and 1921.
 
• But after, 1921 it has shown an increased pattern only.

questions.question: What does GNP stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gross National Product.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• GNP - **Gross National Product.**__ 
 
• It is the total value of all the final products and services in a given period in terms of production by a country's residents.
 
• It is calculated by taking the sum of personal consumption expenditures, domestic investment, expenditure by government, net exports, and any income earned by residents from overseas investments, and deducting the income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
 
• GDP is Gross Domestic Product. It is the national output produced in a country.
 
• GNP = GDP + net property income from abroad

questions.question: X and Y are two stations that are 280 km apart. A train starts at a certain time from X and travels towards Y at 60 km/h. After 2 hours, another train starts from Y and travels towards X at 20 km/h After how many hours does the train leaving from X meet the train which left from Y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between X and Y is 280km

Speed of the first train = 60 km/hr

Speed of second train = 20 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by first train in 2 hr = 60 × 2 = 120 km

Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km

Relative speed, if opposite direction = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr

Time when both train meet = 160/80 = 2 hr

Total time when they meet = 2 hr + 2 hr =** 4 hr**

**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

You will not learn cycling __unless you don't try.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__unless you try__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Unless you don't try'** is wrongly used.
 
• 
 You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

 **Examples:**

 
 
• 
 *We cannot understand disease unless we understand the person who has the disease.*
 
 
• 
 *I'm not happy unless I ride or drive every day.*
 
 
 
 
• **Unless’** expresses a condition and is always used in the** negative sense.**
 
• **‘Not’** is never used with ‘**unless**’ as it leads to double negatives making it superfluous.
 
 
• Example: *Unless you study diligently, you'll never understand trigonometry.* 
 
 

**Thus the correct sentence will be: ***You will not learn cycling **unless you try.__***

When we change the direct speech to indirect speech, the following changes take place:

 
• The Reporting Verb **'said to'** changes to **'asked'.**
 
• Inverted commas are omitted and the **question mark is replaced with a full stop.**
 
• **'If/whether' is added** when it changes from direct to indirect mode.
 
• Modal auxiliary **'can' changes to 'could'.**
 
• The personal pronoun **'I' changes to 'he'.**
 
• Time phrase changes from **'now' to 'then'.**

• When we refer to *time, 'week' is made possessive.*

Thus the correct sentence will be: *Our new office will become operational in a week's time.__*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The possessive case is also used with nouns denoting time.
 
 
• Examples:*** A day’s march, a week’s holiday, yesterday’s newspaper, today’s match.***

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Fortunately, the fire did not cause much damage.

options.text: Fortunately, not much damage is caused by the fire.
Fortunately, not much damage was caused by the fire.
Fortunately, not much damage was being caused by the fire.
Fortunately, not much damage is being caused by the fire.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fortunately, not much damage was caused by the fire.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

The given sentence is in **Active Voice**. Its structure is: **Adverb + subject + auxiliary verb + negative marker + main verb + object**

It needs to be changed in **Passive Voice**. Its structure will be: **Fortunately + negative marker + Object + helping verb + V3 + by + Subject.**

Thus the correct sentence will be: *Fortunately, not much damage was caused by the fire.*

**Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:**

 
• Identify the subject, the verb and the object: S+V+O
 
• Change the object into subject
 
• The active verb does not have an object. Therefore, the passive form should begin with **you.**
 
• Change the verb into past participle of the verb
 
• Change the subject into object

Other options are therefore incorrect as it does not follow the rules of conversion.

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. These baits were temptations that people couldn't resist.

B. He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap.

C. Once, a peddler sat looking at his rat-traps.

D. Here, people lay baits for others.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

**When we connect the sentences it is important to establish a connection between them.**

The sentences here talk about a man who is unhappy and dejected about the situation around him.

 
• **Sentence C** introduces us to the subject **'a peddler'** where he analyzes his rat-traps.

 *Rat-traps is an unpleasant situation with no prospect of improvement.*
 
• **B follows C.** He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap.
 
• **DA follows as a pair.** It states that people lay (baits) traps for others such that people could not resist.
 
• **Thus the correct order is CBDA.**

*Once, a peddler sat looking at his rat-traps. He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap. Here, people lay baits for others. These baits were temptations that people couldn't resist.*
